description: Send a message on a booking's conversation. With source host (default) it is delivered to the GUEST through their channel (Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, email) and cannot be unsent; with source internalNote it is a private host note. Beds24: POST /bookings/messages.

source.description: host (to the guest, default) or internalNote (private).

name: beds24_send_booking_message
title: Send a booking message
